selection: July coverage >=98%, two volume tercile stations per borough
weather_definition: research threshold: hourly rain >=10mm or trailing six-hour rain >=30mm
forecast_task: conditional on realized target-day weather; not an operational ex-ante forecast
supplementary: 2023 ACS released after 2023; 2026 current network/ADA only retrospective contextual probes, excluded from primary forecasts
